title: Scan-run start envelope (v1)
description: Opens a scan run. The collector generates run_id, so a retried start is idempotent: re-posting an identical start returns the existing run rather than creating a second one. The declared scopes state what this run intends to enumerate completely; nothing may ever be marked absent outside a scope a run both declared and reconciled.

run_id.description: Collector-generated UUID. It is the idempotency key for the whole run.

scopes.description: What this run intends to enumerate completely. An empty list is invalid: a run that claims no scope can never reconcile, and would accumulate observations nobody can interpret as coverage.

incremental.description: true when the run deliberately re-reads only part of its scopes. An incremental run must never reconcile: unseen objects were not looked at.

mode.description: Contract 1.4. Why this run is or is not incremental. Omitted by collectors predating 1.4, in which case the server derives it from `incremental`. When present it must agree with `incremental`.

job.description: Contract 1.4. The scheduled job this run belongs to, as named in the orchestrator configuration. Free-form: the server groups and reports by it and never interprets it. Required if the run sends a checkpoint, because a checkpoint is the resume point of a job.

baseline.description: Contract 1.4. The checkpoint this delta resumed from, recorded so that a later gap can be attributed to a particular run. Permitted only when mode is 'delta': a full run resumes from nothing.
